title: MTN Foundation Science & Technology Scholarship
description: MTN Foundation scholarships for students of Nigerian public tertiary institutions: ₦300,000 until graduation for 300-level science and technology students (400-level for medicine), a scheme for blind students (200 and 300 level), and awards for the top 10 UTME scorers announced by JAMB.
date: Annual - dates are not published on the scholarship page
eligibility: Science & Technology Scholarship: 300-level science/technology students or 400-level medical students at Nigerian public tertiary institutions (minimum CGPA 3.5/5.0). Scholarship for Blind Students: 200 and 300 level. Before university, only the top 10 UTME scorers announced by JAMB qualify.

title: NNPC Ltd / Chevron JV National University Scholarship Awards
organizer: Chevron Nigeria Limited (operator of the NNPC Ltd/Chevron Joint Venture)
description: Annual national university scholarship from the NNPC Ltd/Chevron Joint Venture for full-time Nigerian undergraduates in eligible disciplines. Applications are made on the Scholastica portal and selection includes a computer-based test (CBT).
date: Annual - the 2026 round closed on 30 June 2026; next round not yet announced
eligibility: Full-time 200-level students admitted in the previous session at accredited Nigerian universities, in eligible disciplines; minimum CGPA 3.5 (2.5 for visually impaired applicants); at least six O'Level credits (five for the special-needs category). Not open to pre-university students.

title: NNPC / Seplat JV National Undergraduate Scholarship
description: Annual national undergraduate scholarship from the NNPC/Seplat Joint Venture for students of accredited federal and state universities. Applications are made online through the Seplat Growth Academy portal; applying is free and only shortlisted candidates are contacted.
date: Annual - the 2026 round ran from 23 February to 13 March 2026; next round not yet announced
eligibility: Undergraduates in their second year (200L) or above at accredited federal or state universities; minimum CGPA 3.5; at least five O'Level credits including English and Mathematics in one sitting. Not open to pre-university students.

title: Agbami Medical & Engineering Professionals Scholarship Scheme (AMEPS)
organizer: Star Deep Water Petroleum Limited (a Chevron company) & Agbami partners
description: National scholarship funded by Star Deep and its Agbami partners for undergraduates in medical and engineering courses at Nigerian universities. There is no scheme page between rounds: the application form is published on the Scholastica portal (used for Chevron-sponsored schemes) when a round opens.
date: Annual - check the Scholastica portal; next round not yet announced
eligibility: Full-time 200-level undergraduates in eligible medical or engineering courses at accredited Nigerian universities (criteria from the last published round; confirm when the next round opens). Applicants cannot apply to other Chevron/NNPC JV scholarships in the same year.

title: Edo State Government Higher Education Scholarship Scheme
organizer: Edo State Ministry of Education / Edo State Scholarship Board
description: State-sponsored bursary and merit awards for indigenes and residents of Edo State admitted into tertiary institutions, with special allowances for healthcare disciplines at UNIBEN.
date: Annual - dates are not published online; check with the Edo State Ministry of Education
eligibility: Edo State indigenes/residents admitted into tertiary institutions.

title: Federal Government of Nigeria Bilateral Education & Tertiary Scholarship
organizer: Federal Ministry of Education (Federal Scholarship Board - FSB)
description: Federal Government scholarship awards administered by the Federal Scholarship Board, including the Nigerian undergraduate award and Bilateral Education Agreement (BEA) awards for study abroad. The Board's own page does not currently load, so check the Federal Ministry of Education website for the annual call.
date: Annual - calls are announced by the Federal Ministry of Education (dates vary)
eligibility: Nigerian students with minimum CGPA / admission in federal universities.

title: Nigeria Health Watch Annual Health Journalism & Essay Challenge
description: Youth essay and advocacy writing competition focused on practical solutions to primary healthcare, maternal health, and epidemic preparedness in Nigeria.

title: United Bank for Africa (UBA) Foundation National Essay Competition
description: Annual national essay competition from the UBA Foundation awarding educational grants to top Nigerian senior secondary school writers.
eligibility: Senior secondary school students in Nigeria (not open to students who have already finished school).

title: Rotary Youth Leadership Awards (RYLA)
organizer: Rotary International (run by local Rotary clubs and districts)
description: Leadership development programme for young people aged 14-30, run by Rotary clubs and districts, covering leadership, ethics, teamwork and community service. Nigerian Rotary districts hold RYLA events each year, usually sponsored by the organising clubs.
date: Annual district events (dates set by each Rotary district)
eligibility: Young people aged 14-30, usually nominated or sponsored through a local Rotary or Rotaract club.

title: Tony Elumelu Foundation (TEF) Entrepreneurship Programme
description: Pan-African entrepreneurship initiative providing business training, world-class mentorship, and $5,000 non-refundable seed capital to innovative young entrepreneurs (including fashion/tailoring and healthcare startups).
date: Annual call - check the TEF website for this year's dates
eligibility: African entrepreneurs aged 18+ with a viable business idea or early-stage business (0-3 years).
